text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

translations.asad: YOU ARE OBSESSED by greed for more and more
until you go down to your graves.
Nay, in time you will come to understand!
translations.sahih: No! You are going to know.

translations.asad: And once again: Nay, in time you will come to understand!
translations.sahih: Then no! You are going to know.

translations.asad: Nay, if you could but understand [it] with an understanding [born] of certainty,
translations.sahih: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...

translations.asad: you would indeed, most surely, behold the blazing fire [of hell]!
translations.sahih: You will surely see the Hellfire.

translations.asad: In the end you will indeed, most surely, behold it with the eye of certainty:
translations.sahih: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

translations.asad: and on that Day you will most surely be called to account for [what you did with] the boon of life!
translations.sahih: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
